name: Order Fulfillment
description: Worked example exercising every notation in the schema: all 3 slice patterns, all 3 scenario kinds, a hotspot, a chapter, and an actor lane. The shipping-partner notification slice also demonstrates automation without a read model (a boundary-crossing Bridge/Reactor: event straight to command, no persisted state needed).

partitioning.description: Each shop on the platform is a tenant: its orders, read models and timers are its own.

shipment-notified.name: Shipment Notified
shipment-notified.description: The shipping partner acknowledged a shipment.

partner-notification-abandoned.name: Partner Notification Abandoned
partner-notification-abandoned.description: The shipping partner could not be told about a shipment, and the runtime has stopped trying.

delivery-failed.name: Delivery Failed
delivery-failed.description: The carrier could not deliver the order.

delivery-overdue.name: Delivery Overdue
delivery-overdue.description: A shipped order has not been reported delivered or failed in time.

place-order.reason: A customer wants to buy items.

ship-order.name: Ship Order

record-partner-notified.description: Records that the shipping partner acknowledged a shipment.
record-partner-notified.reason: The shipping partner needs to know about the shipment to process it.

record-partner-notification-abandoned.name: Record Partner Notification Abandoned
record-partner-notification-abandoned.description: Records that the shipping partner could not be told about a shipment.

record-delivery.name: Record Delivery
record-delivery.description: The carrier reports how a delivery attempt went.

flag-delivery-overdue.name: Flag Delivery Overdue
flag-delivery-overdue.description: Marks a shipped order whose delivery has taken too long.
flag-delivery-overdue.reason: Someone should chase the carrier before the customer has to.

order-summary.name: Order Summary

pending-shipments.name: Pending Shipments
pending-shipments.question: Which orders are waiting to be shipped?

carrier-webhook.name: Carrier Webhook
carrier-webhook.description: The shipping partner calls this to report delivery attempts. It redelivers on any non-2xx response, so every call carries the carrier's own event id.

auto-ship-pending-orders.name: Auto-Ship Pending Orders
auto-ship-pending-orders.description: Reacts to newly placed orders by shipping them.

notify-shipping-partner-automation.name: Notify Shipping Partner
notify-shipping-partner-automation.description: When a shipment leaves the warehouse, calls the shipping partner's API and records whether the partner acknowledged it. No local state needed.

delivery-overdue-timer.name: Delivery Overdue Timer
delivery-overdue-timer.description: Flags an order that has neither been delivered nor failed some days after shipping.

reconcile-pending-shipments.name: Reconcile Pending Shipments
reconcile-pending-shipments.description: Every so often, retries shipping any order still waiting, in case its first attempt was lost.
